title: AI-Powered One-Person Dev Business
audience: Solo developers who want to increase operating capacity without pretending the business can run itself.
shortDescription: Use AI to increase the operating capacity of a solo development business.
coreOutcome: Design responsible AI-assisted operating workflows across the business.
problem: Isolated prompts save moments; they do not create a dependable operating system.
situation: AI is used ad hoc across research, delivery, sales, and administration without shared context or controls.
commonFailure: Automating tasks without ownership, review criteria, and state creates hidden errors and fragmented work.
methodology: Map recurring work, define inputs and outputs, add AI where useful, retain judgment checkpoints, and measure capacity and quality.
capabilities: Connect workflows into a coherent solo operating model
whoItsFor: Independent developers with repeatable work worth systematizing
whoItsNotFor: Anyone seeking autonomous business operation or a generic prompt pack
